title: Dispatcher-level unknown-flag rejection for every bee.mjs verb (registry-driven) + red-first regression
action: Per D4 (friction: capture add --text exit 0, wrote nothing, 2 settlements nearly lost): (1) RED FIRST — add test to packages/bee/tests/test_bee_cli.mjs: `bee capture add --text "x"` must exit non-zero naming the unknown flag AND missing required --outcome; run it, record the red output BEFORE the fix. (2) In the bee.mjs dispatcher, after resolving the verb's registry entry, validate the parsed flags map against entry.parameters.properties: any flag not in properties -> throw 'unknown flag --X for <group verb> (known: ...)'; also enforce entry.parameters.required missing -> the existing requireFlag error (keep message shape). Central, one place — remove now-redundant per-verb strict loops (update :1236-1239, worker prune :3084) only if behavior stays identical, else leave them. Mind legitimate global flags (--json, --help, BEE_* env) — allow-list globals explicitly. (3) Run the FULL suite: any suite red because a caller passed an undeclared flag = a registry schema gap — fix the registry entry (declare the flag), never loosen the validator. (4) Mirror refresh: the vendored .bee/bin/bee.mjs must pick the change up via REGEN OBLIGATION: node scripts/render_plugin_skill_trees.mjs, then node packages/bee/scripts/onboard_bee.mjs --repo-root . --apply, then node scripts/release_manifest.mjs --write.
